label: @pyreon/zero
notes: Resolves @pyreon/* from the workspace's built lib/ (the harness package examples/stacks-bench declares them as workspace:* deps; this arm has no lockfile of its own).

Node adapter runner: node:http createServer → static-file lookup (readFile per request for assets) → Request construction → createServer() pipeline (app middleware, route middleware, actions, /_pyreon/data) → renderPage; the Response body is piped with a reader loop.
No compression at all (the node runner has no compression middleware).
Listens on all interfaces (the node runner reads PORT, not HOST).
